source_text: Si anima audierit vocem iuramenti et testis sit et non renuntiaverit, accipiet peccatum. Silentium consciorum reatus est. Veritas in ore ecclesiae.
pass_a_gloss: If soul will-have-heard voice of-oath and witness is and not will-have-announced, will-receive sin. Silence of-knowing-ones guilt is. Truth in mouth of-church.
pass_b_english: If a soul [[hears an oath and is a witness yet does not speak, she bears sin >> Bible:Leviticus 5:1]]. Silence of those who know is guilt. Truth belongs in the church’s mouth.
